short_description: Grades the Mac's hardening state and flags unsigned launchd persistence + high-risk privacy-permission exposure. Read-only, network-denied, all-metadata.
long_description:
A read-only security-posture collector. It probes the Mac's hardening controls and emits a single graded report plus per-control findings:

• SIP, FileVault, Gatekeeper — the critical controls
• Application Firewall (+ stealth mode)
• XProtect malware-definition freshness
• Download quarantine (LSQuarantine)
• Launchd persistence integrity — resolves each LaunchDaemon/LaunchAgent program and code-signs it; flags unsigned / ad-hoc / unverifiable entries (the security payoff)
• Privacy-permission exposure (TCC) — counts high-risk grants and lists the non-Apple bundle-ids holding them; never the grant bodies or TCC.db contents

Emits verdicts, counts and paths only — no file contents, no secrets, no message/mail data. Score (0–100) + letter grade is the headline.
data_sources: SIP / FileVault / Gatekeeper / firewall state (system tools)
TCC.db (summary counts + non-Apple client ids only)
